records.title: Impact of creation of additional seats in ITIs
details: c: The PM-SETU scheme is presently in the pre-implementation stage, wherein States/UTs are undertaking industry partner selection through Request for proposals (RFPs). Following this, a Special Purpose Vehicle (SPV) is to be constituted, which will prepare a strategic Secretary, MSDE. Accordingly, operationalization of upgraded ITIs and commencement of training is proposed to take place in a phased manner.

records.title: Amendment to Motor Vehicles Act
details: a to b: Yes Sir. The amendments to the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 are under active consideration.

records.title: MOHALI- Rajpura Railway Project
details: a to c): Rajpura- Mohali new line project (18.11 Km) has been sanctioned recently at a coast of Rs. 443.29 crore. The process of land acquisition has already been initiated. The project has been declared as special Railway Project. Competent Authority for land Acquisition (CALA) has also bee nominated in November 2025.
